articles.title: All four ‘Lord of the Rings’ movie Hobbits explored Boston together this weekend
articles.description:
Sean Astin, Elijah Wood, Dominic Monaghan, and Billy Boyd posted from various Boston sites during the Fan Expo.

The post All four ‘Lord of the Rings’ movie Hobbits explored Boston together this weekend appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Hobbits Sean Astin, Elijah Wood, Dominic Monaghan, and Billy Boyd visited Boston during Fan Expo weekend.
They shared posts from iconic Boston sites, engaging local fans and boosting tourism interest.
The event highlights Boston's appeal as a destination for pop culture enthusiasts.

articles.title: Taylor Farms recalls jalapeno products over salmonella concerns
articles.description:
Taylor Fresh Foods said that it is no longer sourcing products from the farmer and will be filling orders from alternative suppliers.

The post Taylor Farms recalls jalapeno products over salmonella concerns appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Taylor Farms recalls jalapeno products due to salmonella concerns affecting local consumers.
The company will stop sourcing from the implicated farmer and seek alternative suppliers.
Boston residents should check their jalapeno products for safety amid the recall.
